en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika) and the Couple on Conditioned (Sappaccayaduka)

A non-indicative, non-reactive, and conditionless state is a condition, by way of object-condition, for a state that is neither indicative-nor-reactive nor conditionless. There are three [types of conditions] in the case of the object;
three in the case of predominance; and three in the case of decisive support. (Abbreviated.)
